reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #18 ("Integrate the Gnosis Safe into your ETHNewYork Project") is a Gitcoin hackathon bounty / grant-style request, not a request for a concrete code change to this repository. Its own body states the deliverable is an external hackathon project that integrates Gnosis Safe ('This bounty asks you to integrate the Safe into your Dapp...', 'We will give out 3 ETH for the best integration of the Gnosis Safe into an ETHNewYork project', criteria: readme/setup instructions, open-source code, proof of #buidling at ETHNewYork). The tracked repository GnosisEcosystemFund/Gnosis-Bounties- is a bounty-listing/docs repo: its default branch master (HEAD 035b22272e38f3381c91dc4343d8074241a6aa44) contains exactly ONE file (README.md); there is no source, manifest, lockfile, CI workflow or AGENTS.md to modify. Additionally the funding is WITHDRAWN: gitcoinbot comment 493917443 (2019-05-20T09:52:58Z) states 'The funding of 3.0 ETH (747.8 USD) attached to this issue has been cancelled by the bounty submitter'. Two independent disqualifiers therefore apply: (1) no repository change is requested, and (2) funding was cancelled. No open PR competes for a fix (only unrelated docs PR #9 adding Submissions/EthBook.md and PR #4 adding a gnosis-buyback/ project). Per the phase rule, the checkout was left unchanged and no fix branch/PR was created. The admission.funding block showing 3 ETH / $6663.315 is a re-quote of the historical ETH amount and does not reflect the cancelled Gitcoin funding.
